description.value: With a thunderous crack, you disappear from your current location and reappear in an unoccupied space within range that you can see, bringing all non-magical, non-living, unattended matter (including objects) in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] with you. Creatures within the emanation must succeed at a Reflex save to avoid falling into the crater you leave behind, taking @Damage[5[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]. Creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] on your arrival space take @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save from the resulting explosion of debris, and the area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. At the GM's discretion, the spell might have additional effects based on the nature of the material teleported with you. If the teleport would cause you to bring another creature—even one inside an extradimensional container—the spell fails.
